overview: GoNext is a professional AI-powered investment platform offering institutional-grade arbitrage strategies. Users can join investment tiers, track daily ROI, earn referral commissions, and manage withdrawals — all through a sleek dark financial interface with gold accents.
features: Three investment tiers: Genesis, Momentum, Velocity with daily ROI rates
Interactive ROI calculator on the packages page
User dashboard with balance, earnings, referral stats, and withdrawal history
Crypto deposit flow with admin-managed wallet addresses
Referral system with unique links and 10% commission tracking
Admin panel for user management, investment oversight, and withdrawal processing
Admin crypto wallet address manager — add, edit, delete crypto addresses
Rank system tracking user progress across 12 levels
Professional dark financial theme with navy and gold design
